description: A bare NUMBER / DECIMAL / NUMERIC is NUMBER(38,0) in Snowflake, so every conversion to it with no explicit scale ROUNDS the value to a whole number - TO_NUMBER(405.958) is 406, 405.958::NUMBER is 406 - and the rounding is HALF_UP away from zero. An explicit (precision, scale), or a NUMBER(p,s) cast, rounds to that scale instead, and TRY_CAST follows the same rule. A format model governs PARSING only and does not imply a scale, so even '999.999' rounds to a whole number - but the input must FIT the format: live-verified, TO_NUMBER('405.958', '9,999.99') and ('405.958', '9,999') both fail because the value carries more fraction digits than the model does. A rounded value lands in OBJECT_CONSTRUCT as an integer rather than a decimal. Converted 1:1 from functions/NumberDefaultScaleTest (now retired).

steps.sql: SELECT TRY_CAST('405.958' AS NUMBER), TRY_CAST('405.958' AS DECIMAL)
